title: Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn & Child Health
subtitle: Care across the continuum from adolescence through pregnancy, birth and early childhood

interventions.title: Family Planning & Reproductive Health
activities: Community education on voluntary, informed FP choices
promote awareness of available methods and services

interventions.title: Maternal Health & Safe Motherhood
activities: Education on early and quality antenatal care
skilled birth attendance and facility delivery

interventions.title: Newborn Health & Survival
activities: community-based newborn health promotion and referral

interventions.title: Child Health, Nutrition & ECD
activities: infant and young-child feeding and nutrition
early childhood development and positive caregiving

interventions.title: Community-Based Linkage & Referral
activities: engage CHWs, leaders and youth groups
promote awareness of available RMNCH services
follow up and link priority clients

title: Immunization, Vaccine Confidence & Disease Prevention

interventions.title: Immunization Demand Generation & Uptake
activities: Community education on the benefits of routine immunization
awareness campaigns for timely, complete childhood immunization

interventions.title: Vaccine Confidence & Misinformation Management
activities: Community dialogues on vaccine concerns and myths

engage trusted religious, traditional and youth leaders

interventions.title: Community-Based Disease Prevention
activities: Health education on priority infectious and vaccine-preventable diseases
support during outbreaks and public-health emergencies

interventions.title: Youth & Community Engagement
activities: Establish youth and community immunization champions
social media and digital platforms for accurate information

interventions.title: Evidence Generation
activities: KAP assessments on immunization and prevention

interventions.title: Health Education & Health Literacy
activities: Community awareness sessions on priority health issues

interventions.title: Youth & Community Participation
activities: Platforms for adolescents and young people in programme decision-making

interventions.title: Behaviour Change & Social Mobilization
activities: dialogues addressing harmful beliefs and practices

interventions.title: Community Champions & Peer Support

interventions.title: Health Equity & Inclusion
activities: Identify social, geographic and economic access barriers

interventions.title: Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning

interventions.title: Health Innovation & Solution Testing
